subject: sarf
definition: A verb that shows an act which happened before the time of speaking.
explanation: نَصَرَ (he helped), كَتَبَ (he wrote). It is conjugated with endings for the fourteen persons: نَصَرَا (they two helped), نَصَرُوا (they helped), نَصَرْتُ (I helped), نَصَرْنَا (we helped).

In naḥw the past tense is mabnī: its ending does not change with the sentence. It is mabnī on fatḥa (نَصَرَ), on ḍamma before the wāw of the plural (نَصَرُوا), and on sukūn before a vowelled pronoun of the doer (نَصَرْتُ).
